description: Given a target file size (KB) and optionally the image's current size and pixel dimensions, says what to expect when compressing to that size — quality, how much resolution is usually kept — based on Pixohub's measured tests on 44 photos, and links the matching compress-to-size tool.

target_kb.description: Maximum file size you need, in KB (1 MB = 1024 KB).
